speakingTopics.title: My Family
speakingTopics.prompt: Tell me about your family. Who lives with you? What is your favorite thing to do with your family?
speakingTopics.sampleResponse: I have a mother, a father, and a sister. My name is Priya. I love my family. We play together. My favorite thing is to play games with them.

assessmentCriteria.clarity: Can the AI understand the response clearly?
assessmentCriteria.vocabulary: Does the student use appropriate words?
assessmentCriteria.fluency: Does the student speak smoothly or with many pauses?

speakingTopics.title: My Pet
speakingTopics.prompt: Do you have a pet? If yes, tell me about it. What is its name? What does it like to do?
speakingTopics.sampleResponse: I have a cat. Her name is Fluffy. Fluffy is orange and white. She likes to sleep and play with a ball. I love my cat.

assessmentCriteria.fluency: Speaks with natural pace and rhythm

speakingTopics.title: My Favorite Food
speakingTopics.prompt: What is your favorite food? Why do you like it? How often do you eat it?
speakingTopics.sampleResponse: My favorite food is apple. I like apples because they are sweet and red. I eat apples every day. Apples are good for me.

assessmentCriteria.grammar: Simple past and present tense correct

speakingTopics.title: What I Like at School
speakingTopics.prompt: What do you like at school? Is it your teacher, your friends, or the activities? Tell me why.
speakingTopics.sampleResponse: I like my school. My teacher is very kind. I have many friends. I like to play with them at lunch time. I also like to read stories in class.
